Mia: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Mia: Did: finalized content calendar for launch week (see table). Pulled last week's benchmark numbers — CTR down ~12% on the hero carousel.
Mia: Blocker: waiting on final hero image from @Leo to run the final A/B creative test.
Mia: Today: rework captions & CTA for top 3 posts; prep canary publish plan for Friday.

Sam: Did: ran the AB cohort for paid+organic funnel, attached summary link https://gdrive/... :mag:
Sam: Note: publish-bot hit rate-limit yesterday during the bulk publish, we retried some items manually.
Sam: Today: will rerun the paid promos after we confirm hero image.

Leo: Sent two variants to #design-assets earlier. Will upload high-res to the calendar by 5pm. :camera_flash:
Leo: Quick Q — confirm preferred aspect is 16:9 for hero? @Mia

Noah: Did: copy edits done for landing & emails. Fixed headline flow.
Noah: Blocker: staging missing tracking snippet so can't QA conversion events.
Noah: Today: will QA once snippet is deployed; can help with captions after Leo uploads.

Olivia: FYI — launch checklist sync at 15:00 PT today. Added canary windows to the checklist.
Olivia: Pinging @publish-bot: can we retry job 12345 (bulk publish) between 16:00–17:00 so we don't overlap paid pushes?

publish-bot: Retry request received for job 12345. Scheduled retry at 16:10 PT. Status: queued.

Sam: :thumbsup: Good. I'll hold the paid promotion until 16:30.

Mia: Thanks. I'll rerun the creative QA once @Leo uploads. Adding quick calendar snippet below for visibility:
```
Thu 09:00 — organic hero post (variant A)
Thu 12:00 — paid promo (cohort alpha)
Fri 08:00 — landing canary 5% traffic
Fri 12:00 — full publish (if canary ok)
```

Mia: Anything else? :eyes:

Leo: 16:9 confirmed. Uploading now.
Noah: Tracking snippet pushed to staging. Will QA and report back by 14:30.
publish-bot: Job 12345 started retry at 16:10 PT. Will post status when complete.

Mia: perfect — thanks all. We'll call out any blockers in the 15:00 sync or here if urgent.
